hotelHighlightSeeds.title: Walkable Jayanagar
hotelHighlightSeeds.summary: Cafes, markets, parks, and the metro are close enough for an unhurried day on foot.

hotelHighlightSeeds.title: Restful rooms
hotelHighlightSeeds.summary: Air conditioning, privacy curtains, and ensuite bathrooms make shared stays easier.

hotelHighlightSeeds.title: A social lounge
hotelHighlightSeeds.summary: Colorful shared spaces create room for games, conversation, and quiet work.

hotelHighlightSeeds.title: Hosts around the clock
hotelHighlightSeeds.summary: The front desk and security team are available at every hour.

hotelHighlightSeeds.title: Strong everyday value
hotelHighlightSeeds.summary: Useful facilities and a central neighborhood without a luxury-hotel premium.

hotelFaqSeeds.question: How can I keep valuables secure?
hotelFaqSeeds.answer: Every dorm bed includes a personal locker. Bring a padlock or ask the front desk where to purchase one nearby.

hotelFaqSeeds.question: Is there a women-only dorm?
hotelFaqSeeds.answer: Yes. The six-bed women’s ensuite dorm is listed separately from the mixed dorms.

hotelFaqSeeds.question: How close is the metro?
hotelFaqSeeds.answer: Jayanagar Metro Station is approximately 750 meters away on foot.

hotelFaqSeeds.question: What can I visit nearby?
hotelFaqSeeds.answer: Lalbagh Botanical Garden, Fourth Block Market, neighborhood cafes, and local shops are all within easy reach.

hotelFaqSeeds.question: Can I bring a pet?
hotelFaqSeeds.answer: Pets require advance confirmation from the property and an additional charge may apply.

hotelPolicySeeds.title: Government identification
hotelPolicySeeds.description: Guests aged 18 or older may check in with valid government-issued identification.

hotelPolicySeeds.title: Group stays
hotelPolicySeeds.description: For more than five rooms, contact the property before submitting an inquiry so group terms can be confirmed.

hotelPolicySeeds.title: Smoke-free spaces
hotelPolicySeeds.description: Smoking is not permitted in rooms or indoor shared spaces.

hotelPolicySeeds.title: Quiet hours
hotelPolicySeeds.description: Quiet hours run from 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM throughout the property.

hotelPolicySeeds.title: Traveling with pets
hotelPolicySeeds.description: Pets require advance confirmation and additional charges may apply.

hotelReviewSeeds.title: Easy neighborhood, thoughtful dorm
hotelReviewSeeds.body: The metro walk was straightforward, the locker felt secure, and the lower bunk was comfortable after a long day in the city.

hotelReviewSeeds.title: A calm private room near the action
hotelReviewSeeds.body: Our room stayed quiet at night, and the front desk gave us excellent recommendations for breakfast and the market.
hotelReviewSeeds.response: Thank you for making Common House part of your Bengaluru visit. We are glad the neighborhood and room gave you the balance you wanted.

hotelReviewSeeds.title: Practical base for a work week
hotelReviewSeeds.body: Reliable common areas, useful laundry service, and quick metro access made a longer stay simple.
